name: fugu-free-model-fleet-operator
description: Maintains exact free-model routes across Fugu, Hermes, OpenCode, and T3 Code with catalog refresh, staged configuration, fail-closed canaries, receipts, and rollback.
write_policy: Snapshot and plan are read-only apart from generated reports. Stage/apply require explicit user intent, bounded backups, fail-closed route gates, and no direct T3 userdata edits.
